title: Body System Mechanism Relationships
description: Maps each body system to the mechanisms that contribute to it, used by the recommendation engine's body-system coverage scoring. The 'evidence' field is denormalised from mechanisms.json and must be kept in sync with it.

id.description: Must match an id in body-systems.json.
Must match an id in mechanisms.json.

priority.description: Relative priority of this mechanism within this body system.

weight.description: Relative scoring weight of this mechanism within this body system.

evidence.description: Must match the evidence value on the corresponding entry in mechanisms.json - this is a denormalised copy, not an independent judgement.

name.description: Denormalised display name - must match the name of the corresponding entry in mechanisms.json.
